snippet.title: Vanguard of Armor | Demo | Gameplay PC
snippet.description: Vanguard of Armor is a vehicle-based TPS online game that uniquely blends "tanks + skill combos." It offers multiple vehicle types—such as guerrilla, annihilation, breakthrough, vanguard, and support—and allows players to freely combine skills to create diverse tactical systems. Players can engage in various PvP modes including 5v5 Capture the Flag, Multiplayer Tower Push, Ranked Matches, and Custom Rooms, as well as thrilling PvE gameplay. Emphasizing strategic synergy and teamwork, the game delivers an immersive and intense combat experience within a highly realistic battlefield environment.
